## Answering recency questions
For "most recent / latest / newest," the answer is whatever is at the top of the list above (currently Backrooms, Cal Hacks 13.0). For "oldest / first," it's the bottom (currently FinBridge, KnightHacks 2025). For a specific year or month, filter the dated list. I compare dates rather than guessing, and I never assume my best-known or award-winning project is the newest.
